score.description: The native leaderboard integer is display score divided by ten. The last displayed decimal digit counts continues and is zero for eligible rounds. Preserve the native integer in the protocol; do not divide again or convert through floating point.

challengeBoard.description: Keep exact medal points; the ordinary display-score multiplier does not apply. The native board definition already sets uploadable=0, so its ranking manager skips the cleared placeholder attachment. No replay or gameplay-script patch is required.

eligibility.description: Keep the game's existing checkRegistRanking conditions, including Black Label round and all-mix restrictions; the presence of a board in the profile is not permission to submit to it.

replayLayout.coreVersionCodeReference: The hash-bound eboot registration at 0xe483 names getEmuVersion, binds 0x14960 via its wrapper, and that leaf returns 0x10000. A real independent ARCADE recording also has data_version 0x10000.

observedPlayback.scope: Cold local MY REPLAY playback to natural return; not a network roundtrip.

replayLayout.description: This is the local save record, not the network attachment. Container version is independent of the selected shipped core revision. Cold local playback has passed; online roundtrip remains separate.

networkReplayLayout.source: base:system/config/struct_replay.psb.m; base:system/script/ranking_ctrl.nut.m upload and download Struct

observedHttpsRoundtrip.scope: Normal collection GUI selection and launch, real ARCADE / Type-A / Shotia round, native score/replay upload, in-game leaderboard and download/save against the deployed HTTPS service. A new normal-contract process with networking disabled and diagnostic tap 0 played this DOWNLOAD REPLAY to natural return. Representative coverage, not every mode or physical-device validation.

observedRoundtrip.scope: Real native score/replay upload, leaderboard read, replay download and native save against loopback; a separate cold process with community disabled played DOWNLOAD REPLAY to natural return. This does not accept production HTTPS, the normal collection entry or every mode.

networkReplayLayout.description: The native ranking producer clears the network Struct and copies named fields from the local record; the downloader uses the same network Struct. Eligible ARCADE can temporarily use raw mode 3: rankingModeConv maps it to board family 0 when ALL-MIX is false, while the network header retains 3. Keep native eligibility checks and CUSTOM board exclusion; do not rewrite replay bytes or borrow Ketsui's versions.

flow: Native score submission precedes replay attachment. The profile has seven character filters, with the combined board last, unlike Ketsui. Representative native ARCADE loopback and normal-collection production HTTPS roundtrips have passed, including downloaded replay save and offline cold playback. Other modes, physical input and release-package acceptance are not implied.
